Counsel for Applicant :- Aman Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Hasan Parvej,Rahul Pandey
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2.  The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.463 of 2022 (State Vs. Mahendra Pal Mehrotra), arising out of Case Crime No.0751 of 2021 Under Sectios 420, 406 I.P.C. Police Station-Baradari, District-Bareilly, pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-1, Bareilly as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 06.11.2024 and charge sheet dated 07.10.2021 on the basis of compromise dated 14.11.2024.
3.

5. Accordingly, it is provided that the parties shall appear before the court below along with a certified copy of this order on the next date fixed.

It is therefore expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next four weeks.
It shall be open to the applicant to file a fresh application U/S 482 at that stage for the relief sought herein.
6. Counsel for the applicant has filed supplementary affidavit annexing therewith original copy of the compromise deed.
The applicant is permitted to file photocopy of the compromise deed/affidavit notarized on 18.11.2024 before the trial court.
7. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
8. For a period of six weeks, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicant.
